camel_example: aliyun live StartLiveMPUTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId yourTaskId --MixMode 0 --AppId yourAppId --ChannelId yourChannelId
description_en: Creates a stream mixing and transcoding task
kebab_example: aliyun live start-live-mpu-task --app-id yourAppId --channel-id yourChannelId --task-id yourTaskId --mix-mode 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartLiveMPUTask

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Only one ID is supported. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only one ID is supported. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. Only one ID is supported. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 55 characters. This ID is the unique identifier for the bypass ingest task.
If a task with the same ID still exists and has not been cleared when you start a new task, \`InvalidParam\` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符。此ID为旁路转推的标识，需保证唯一。
启动任务时，如果同ID任务还在，未被清理，会返回InvalidParam
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream mixing mode. Valid values:

0: Single-stream ingest. The original single stream is ingested without stream mixing or transcoding. You do not need to configure stream mixing and transcoding parameters.

1 (default): Stream mixing and transcoding
parameters.help_zh:
混流模式。取值：
0：单路转推，不混流转码，仅转推原始单路流，无需配置混流转码参数。
1（默认值）：混流转码转推
parameters.name: mix_mode

parameters.help_en:
The live ingest URL. Only the RTMP protocol is supported. Only one URL is supported. The maximum length is 2048 characters. For information about how to generate the URL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html.

For domain names with hotlink protection enabled, the ingest URL must include an access token.

Do not use the same StreamURL in different tasks at the same time.

Do not use the same StreamURL within 10 seconds after a task stops
parameters.help_zh:
直播推流地址，仅支持RTMP协议，仅支持传单个地址，最大长度不超过2048个字符。生成规则请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html。

对已开防盗链鉴权的域名，需要在推流地址中包含鉴权串。
禁止同一个StreamURL在不同任务中同时使用。
任务停止10S之内，禁止使用同一个StreamURL
parameters.name: stream_url

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to ingest the stream to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

false: Ingest to a non-Alibaba Cloud CDN.

true: Ingest to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

The default value is false
fields.help_zh:
是否转推到阿里云CDN。
false为转推非阿里云CDN。
true为转推阿里云CDN。

该参数默认为false
fields.name: is_ali_cdn

fields.help_en: The live ingest URL. Only the RTMP protocol is supported. The maximum length is 2048 characters. For information about how to generate the URL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html
fields.help_zh: 直播推流地址，仅支持RTMP协议，最大长度不超过2048个字符。生成规则请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199339.html
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for ingesting to multiple URLs. You can specify multiple live ingest URLs.

When you set the ingest URL for a task, you must configure either the StreamURL parameter or the MultiStreamURL parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
多地址转推参数，可填写多个直播推流地址。
在设置任务的转推地址时，StreamURL参数与MultiStreamURL参数，只能配置其中一个参数，且必须配置其中一个参数
parameters.name: multi_stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The region where the stream mixing service is located. Valid values:

CN-Shanghai<props="china">(default)</props>: Shanghai.

AP-Singapore<props="intl">(default)</props>: Singapore.

EMAA-Saudi: Saudi Arabia
parameters.help_zh:
请求的混流服务所在区域。取值：

CN-Shanghai<props="china"><ph>（默认值）</ph></props>：上海。
AP-Singapore<props="intl"><ph>（默认值）</ph></props>：新加坡。
EMAA-Saudi：沙特
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The idle timeout period. Unit: seconds. The value must be in the range of [10, 86400].

If you set this parameter, the task is automatically stopped when it has been idle for a period longer than MaxIdleTime. If you do not set this parameter, the task is stopped immediately after the channel is closed
parameters.help_zh:
空闲超时时间；单位为秒，取值范围为[10,86400]。
设置此参数后，会在任务处于空闲状态的时长大于 MaxIdleTime 时，自动停止该任务；若不设置此参数，则会在房间关闭后，立刻停止该任务
parameters.name: max_idle_time

fields.help_en:
The type of video input stream in single-stream ingest mode. This parameter is valid only for video streams (StreamType=2). Valid values:

camera (default): Camera stream.

shareScreen: Screen sharing stream
fields.help_zh:
单流转推模式下视频输入流类型，仅针对视频流（StreamType=2）有效。取值：
camera（默认值）：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The type of stream to ingest in single-stream ingest mode. Valid values:

0 (default): Ingest the original stream.

1: Ingest only the audio stream.

2: Ingest only the video stream
fields.help_zh:
单流转推模式下转推流类型。取值：
0（默认值）：转推原始流。
1：仅转推音频流。
2：仅转推视频流
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the user whose stream is ingested. Only one stream can be ingested at a time
fields.help_zh: 单流转推的用户ID，一次只能转推一路流
fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The parameters for single-stream ingest. This parameter is required when MixMode is set to 0. Do not set this parameter for stream mixing and transcoding
parameters.help_zh: 单流转推参数，单流转推（MixMode=0）时必填。需要混流转码时不填
parameters.name: single_sub_params

fields.help_en:
The display mode of the output video. Valid values:

1 (default): Clip

子画面输出时的显示模式：
0：缩放并显示黑底。

fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the global background image. The maximum length is 2048 characters
fields.help_zh: 全局背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The global background image for the mixed stream
fields.help_zh: 混流全局背景图
fields.name: background

fields.help_en: The audio bitrate. Unit: kbps. The value must be in the range of [8, 500]
fields.help_zh: 音频码率，取值范围：[8, 500]，单位：kbps
fields.name: audio_bitrate

fields.help_en: The number of audio channels. Valid values: 1, 2
fields.help_zh: 音频声道数，取值：1、2
fields.name: audio_channels

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the stream is audio-only. Valid values:

true: Audio-only. You only need to set audio-related parameters.

false (default): Not audio-only. All parameters except VideoCodec and EnhancedParam must be specified
fields.help_zh:
是否为纯音频，取值：
true：纯音频，仅需要设置音频相关参数。
false（默认值）：非纯音频，除VideoCodec参数与EnhancedParam参数外，其它参数均不能为空
fields.name: audio_only

fields.help_en: The audio sampling rate. Unit: Hz. Valid values: 8000, 16000, 32000, 44100, 48000
fields.name: audio_sample_rate

fields.help_en:
The enhanced encoding parameters. This is a JSON string. The supported optional configurations include \`profile\` and \`preset\`.

\`profile\`: The encoding profile. If the video encoding format is H.264, valid values for \`profile\` include "baseline", "main", and "high". If the video encoding format is H.265, the valid value for \`profile\` is "main".

\`preset\`: Balances encoding speed and quality. Valid values for \`preset\` include "ultrafast", "superfast", "veryfast", "faster", "fast", "medium", "slow", "slower", "veryslow", and "placebo". Each value represents a strategy for balancing encoding speed and output video quality, from "ultrafast" (fastest encoding speed) to "placebo" (highest quality, slowest encoding speed).

For example, "superfast" is mainly used for real-time communication. If you are not an expert in encoders, do not set this option
fields.help_zh:
编码增强参数，JSON字符串，目前支持的可选配置包括profile与preset。
profile：编码级别。当视频编码格式为H.264时，profile支持的可选值包括："baseline", "main", "high"；当视频编码格式为H.265时，profile支持的可选值包括："main"。

preset：调节编码速度和质量的平衡。preset支持的可选值包括："ultrafast", "superfast", "veryfast", "faster", "fast", "medium", "slow", "slower", "veryslow" "placebo"。每个值代表了一种编码速度与输出视频质量的策略，从"ultrafast"（极快，编码速度优先）到"placebo"（追求极致质量，编码极慢）。

例如设置superfast，主要用于实时通讯领域。建议非编码器专业技术人员，不设置该选项
fields.name: enhanced_param

fields.help_en: The video bitrate. Unit: kbps. The value must be in the range of [1, 10000]
fields.help_zh: 视频码率，取值范围：[1, 10000]，单位：kbps
fields.name: video_bitrate

fields.help_en:
The video encoding format. Valid values:

H.264 (default).

H.265
fields.help_zh:
视频编码格式。取值：
H.264（默认值）。
H.265
fields.name: video_codec

fields.help_en: The video frame rate. Unit: fps. The value must be in the range of [1, 60]
fields.help_zh: 视频帧率，取值范围：[1, 60]，单位：fps
fields.name: video_framerate

fields.help_en: The video GOP size. The value must be in the range of [1, 60]
fields.help_zh: 视频GOP，取值范围：[1, 60]
fields.name: video_gop

fields.help_en: The video height. Unit: pixels. The value must be in the range of [0, 1920]
fields.help_zh: 视频高，取值范围：[0, 1920]，单位：px
fields.name: video_height

fields.help_en: The video width. Unit: pixels. The value must be in the range of [0, 1920]
fields.help_zh: 视频宽，取值范围：[0, 1920]，单位：px
fields.name: video_width

fields.help_zh: 转推输出的编码参数
fields.name: encode_params

fields.help_zh: 子画面的背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符。当用户关闭摄像头或未进入房间时，会在布局位置填充为此图片
fields.name: background_image_url

fields.help_en: The height of the pane, as a normalized percentage
fields.help_zh: 窗格高，归一化百分比
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The display mode of the output video pane. Valid values:

0: Scale and display a black background.

1 (default): Clip
fields.help_zh:
子画面输出时的显示模式，取值：
0：缩放并显示黑底。
1（默认值）：裁剪
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The ID of the channel where the user is located. You do not need to set this parameter for users in the same channel. For cross-channel stream mixing, set this parameter
fields.help_zh: 混流用户所在的频道ID，同频道内混流的用户可不填，跨频道混流时建议填写该参数
fields.name: channel_id

fields.help_en:
The type of video input stream in stream mixing and transcoding mode. This parameter is valid only for video streams (StreamType=2). Valid values:

camera (default): Camera stream.

shareScreen: Screen sharing stream

混流转码模式下视频输入流类型，仅针对视频流（StreamType=2）有效。取值：
camera（默认值）：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享

fields.help_en: The user ID

fields.help_en:
The information about the user corresponding to this pane. If you do not set this parameter, the system automatically fills it based on the order in which streamers join the channel.

If you specify user information, that user must already be configured in the \`TranscodeParams.UserInfos\` parameter.

This parameter is valid only for original streams and video streams
fields.help_zh:
该窗格对应的混流用户信息，不填时后台按照上行主播的进房顺序自动填充。
如果指定混流用户信息，该用户信息需要已在TranscodeParams.UserInfos参数中配置。 
仅针对原始流和视频流有效
fields.name: user_info

fields.help_en: The width of the pane, as a normalized percentage
fields.help_zh: 窗格宽，归一化百分比
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The X-coordinate, as a normalized percentage
fields.help_zh: 坐标X，归一化百分比
fields.name: x

视频布局信息。
视频转码时，需要指定视频布局信息，包括布局坐标(X，Y)，布局窗格(Width，Height)，叠放顺序(ZOrder)；纯音频转码时，禁止填写视频布局信息

fields.help_zh: 混流时订阅用户所在的频道ID，同频道内混流的用户可不填，跨频道混流时建议填写该参数
